Package com.csse3200.game.components.shop

Class ScratchCardGame

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.shop.ScratchCardGame
public final class ScratchCardGame extends Object
............... Scratch Card: the player buys a card with three hidden symbols and scratches each one. Three matching symbols pay out by symbol, two matching symbols return half the stake, and no match pays nothing.
